description: This file defines dependency injection providers and authentication state management for a Flutter app using the Provider package. It includes a function to build global providers and a ChangeNotifier class to track authentication status and user info.

classes.name: AuthState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that listens to Firebase auth state changes and updates the app with the user's sign-in status and info.

methods.name: buildGlobalProviders
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of global provider widgets for dependency injection.

methods.name: AuthState._
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the AuthState and subscribing to auth state changes.
